hits.title: Capital One to Acquire Brex for $5.15Bn | DelMorgan
hits.snippet: # Capital One to Acquire Brex for $5.15Bn: Expanding to Corporate Payments Software Feb 23, 2026 DelMorgan & Co. DelMorgan & Co. Capital One Financial Corporation has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Brex, a financial technology company specializing in corporate cards and expense management software, for approximately $5.15Bn. The transaction consideration is structured as approximately 50% cash and 50% Capital One common stock. Brex was previously valued at approximately $12.3Bn in early 2022, and the current transaction reflects broader valuation adjustments across the fintech sector in recent years. [...] ### Integration Considerations and Transaction Risk The Brex transaction is expected to close around mid-2026, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. Integration execution will be a key factor in determining whether Capital One realizes anticipated benefits. Combining a fintech operating model with a large bank’s regulatory, compliance and operational requirements may introduce integration complexity. Capital One has indicated that the Brex acquisition is not expected to materially alter the pace of its ongoing share repurchase program.

hits.snippet: Capital One announced it will acquire Brex in a roughly $5.1 billion cash and stock transaction, expected to close in mid-2026. Brex was founded in 2017 and built a large presence in corporate cards, spend management, and payments, particularly among venture backed and growth stage companies. At its peak, Brex carried a private valuation above $12 billion. The acquisition price reflects how fintech valuations have reset as markets shifted toward profitability, scale, and sustainable revenue. This deal is notable for several reasons. First is valuation. The gap between Brex’s peak valuation and the acquisition price highlights how quickly expectations changed once capital tightened and growth without margins stopped being rewarded. [...] 📈 \\Scale Meets Innovation\\: Capital One brings $475.8B in deposits and sophisticated underwriting. Brex brings cutting-edge AI agents and 25,000+ customers including DoorDash, TikTok, and Robinhood. The result? A payments powerhouse that can serve everyone from startups to enterprises. 🔥 \\The Real Kicker\\: Pedro Franceschi (Brex's founder) stays to lead the company.
